thread:
tess: Quick heads-up — planning to flip on per-customer VIP allowlist for AcmeCo tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a final ops check.
omar: thanks — what's the exact scope? full feature or just beta toggles?
tess: just the customer-scoped flag 'feature_x_vip' behind contract gating. Only users in AcmeCo allowlist should get it.
jin: also confirm rollback path. If latency/failures spike we want to disable at org-level fast.
tess: yes — rollout plan: 1) enable allowlist in config service, 2) enable flag for AcmeCo account id only, 3) monitor traces + error rate for 15m, 4) widen to 10% of org if stable.
kai: can we add a safety-net fallback to default model variant if the feature path errors? (prefer no user-visible 500s)
tess: good call. I'll add adaptive fallback: when feature handler throws, route to stable model variant and emit metric 'vip_allowlist.handler_error'.
omar: what about burst limits? AcmeCo might send heavy traffic — need token bucket for VIP path or queue to dedicated pool.
jin: we already have per-tenant qos on the ingress; recommend adding a separate route in routing table to Dedicated pool and set soft limit 100tps. If exceeded, degrade to hosted fallback.
tess: configs I'll touch: flags-service: allowlists.acmeco = [org:12345], rollout.acmeco_pct = 0, routing.acmeco_pool = dedicated-vip, fallback_route = hosted-stable.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: flags-service v2.18 -> canary at 08:30 PT, full at 09:00 PT. See runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/vip-allowlist
kai: code review ping @omar @jin — small change in flags-service to short-circuit clients not in allowlist. Diff: https://git/PR/8762
omar: on it, will review now.
jin: I'll add observability: dashboard tile for latency by org, error counter, and a synthetic check hitting a VIP-only flow.
tess: TY. Last check: are contract entitlements synced to allowlist generator? We must ensure no drift between billing and flags.
omar: current sync job runs hourly. I can add a one-off sync pre-rollout and a fast re-sync post-rollout.
tess: perfect. I'll do pre-rollout sync at 08:45 PT, then trigger release-bot. If anything looks off we abort and set rollout.acmeco_pct=0. :thumbsup:
kai: quick note — ensure audit logs include who flipped the flag (for legal/compliance).
tess: logging already includes actor metadata; I'll add an explicit audit event for the contract-gate flip.
jin: ok. Monitoring alert thresholds: set latency > 200ms for VIP flow OR error rate > 0.5% => page EngOncall.
release-bot: alert policy created: VIP-Allowlist-AcmeCo. Pager: eng-oncall.
omar: LGTM from me after small nit in unit tests.
tess: great — thanks team. I'll post post-mortem template link after rollout.
omar: remember to notify CS and AM so they can communicate to AcmeCo support channels.
tess: will do. End-to-end checklist done. Leaving this thread pinned for the rollout window.
